summary: HPS Corporate Capital Solutions Fund filed an 8-K to report a routine sale of common shares in a continuing monthly offering. On April 1, 2026, it issued 188,132 Class I and 419,457 Class D shares at $26.88 per share (at NAV) for aggregate proceeds of $16.34M. The issuance was exempt under Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D/S. The filing also declared April 2026 distributions ($0.1390/share) and disclosed March 2026 NAV of $26.88/share, a portfolio fair value of $2.2B, and debt of $964.3M. This is a standard periodic disclosure for an interval fund; no special situation event is present.
